notes: Bare printed names written with Street: TURRILL, APPLE, BROOKSIDE, LINGO, KNOWLTON, CHERRY, BLUE ROCK; INGOT (12 ft) written as Ingot Alley; its continuation south of the 16 ft alley is printed only ALLEY here but labelled INGOT ALLEY on 624, so it is recorded as Ingot Alley too. Turrill is in two pieces: Chase to the asylum boundary, and Palm to Blue Rock and beyond. Blue Rock is printed 130' wide from the west edge to Turrill and 60' east of Turrill. Knowlton jogs at Hamilton (two T points). The north legs at Chase/Turrill and Chase/Hamilton are unlabelled on this sheet. The double dashed lines down Hamilton are water pipes / car tracks, not street lines. Circled numbers are grade elevations.
